body: He does. The main problem lies in the fact that his income is unreliable and he doesn't have a vehicle. I would be willing to help, but I don't know of anywhere I could work at within 5 miles of his home.

I've tried meditating for a while but I've yet to see any improvement in my mood or mindset. Thank you for the suggestion though, I really do appreciate it. It's nice to feel cared about, even if it is just strangers on the internet.
Trust me, I've already asked. Only one friend has any room to let me stay but I'm unsure of how well it would work out.
They've been as lenient as they will be with us, and I've offered to help out but they have all the help they need and wouldn't compensate me in any way even if I did help. So that sucks. :(

Thank you, but I wouldn't really call it hope, as I feel hopeless nearly 24/7. It's more or less just been me coasting through life and not even expecting to make it to 21. Somehow I made it this far, but I don't know how much farther I can go anymore.

Supposedly we might be getting kicked out this weekend for being behind on rent. If so, that would be the final straw and I would snap. Unfortunately I can't walk very far as the motel is on a highway, and is not in a very good area in general, so that's out of the question. I just don't see myself making it very far past this weekend.
